descriptionChirho: Proper noun שָׁפָן (Shaphan): primarily the scribe/secretary who served under King Josiah and read the discovered Book of the Law (2 Kgs 22:3-14; 2 Chr 34:8-20), also the father of Ahikam, Elasah, and Gemariah (Jer 26:24; 29:3; 36:10-12). S143553 covers bare and conjunctive occurrences of the name (29x), while S143554 is a single conjunctive use 'and Shaphan'. All translations preserve the same anthroponym: eng Shaphan, spa Shafan/Safán, hin शापान/शाफ़ान, arb شَافَان, kor 샤반/사반, swa Shafani. No semantic distinction exists.
